expectation: Membrane rings on T cells only. Count varies by region: single cells scattered through tumour and stroma, and dense infiltrates or aggregates in the stroma and lymphoid areas. Tumour nests and non-immune tissue should stay negative.
observed: A: CD3 cells are scattered singly in some ROIs and form dense aggregates in others, and density differs strongly between ROIs. B and C: few discrete bright cells over negative tissue. D: membrane-like rings of signal. E: CD3 overlaps CD4 (white), with some CD3+CD4− green cells.
why: Discrete T-cell-like cells and aggregates whose density varies by region, sitting on a subset of CD4+ cells, with CD3+CD4− cells too, as T cells should.
notes: CD3 marks discrete cells and dense lymphoid infiltrates whose density varies by ROI, and fields B and C are mostly negative. In row E, CD3 overlaps CD4 cells, and some CD3+ cells lack CD4 (likely CD8 T cells). This is a specific T-cell stain.
